Address me by my title, Minthara. Grand Duke Ravengard.
|I just work here, protecting the globe.|
But I am glad to see you're living life to the fullest. We deserve nothing less, you and I.
Much as I fear your lady's blessings, I'll take it. Good to see you too, buddy.
Then we'll all be able to look out for each other.
Provides an image quality similar to native rendering, with a major performance gain.
Might I trouble you for another kiss?
Breathe deep, Boo! The smell of hero sings from every stone in this place!
Player [1] is choosing how to react.
Minthara is my home, as unbelievable as it might sound.
*It is a request to join a celebration for those who stood against the Absolute.*
Karlach: You look positively perfect, and only ever so slightly singed.
I relinquished the Crown of Karsus to Mystra on one condition - she relinquished any claim held over me. She accepted.
I tried to use the Crown of Karsus to kill Mystra and become the God of Magic. It didn't go well.
You're looking a bit less... 'solid' than I expected.

After reading 'The Legend of Ansur', I discovered the great wyrm Ansur resides in a secret lair called the Wyrmway. The entrance is apparently located somewhere within Wyrm's Rock Prison, and the notes inside it hint that opening the way involves lightning sparks and torches.
I'll need to see this place for myself.
No. I did what I set out to do, and I left the world I loved.
Sometimes I could swear that squirrel is looking at me funny...
Xan is safe - don't you worry that horned head of yours.
*Those who stood with you against the Absolute. Those you were parted from so suddenly when the victory was won.*
Yes, Wyll. I am a paragon of virtue. I volunteer at a local orphanage, and rehabilitate wounded owlbear cubs.
I think I've caught up with everyone. What comes next?
The gate of her heart closed to you. In the earth or in the stars, it would have mattered not.
And our little hatchling? Is he safe?
You are correct, but our differences are unimportant when it comes to this matter.
Those drawn to the Galerian creed don't merely seek my guidance as the impressive, all-powerful being I've become.
You always did have a great fire in your belly. I'm glad to be the one to keep it kindled.
Ansur was a pile of bones. I will defeat the Absolute on my own terms, and become a Grand Duke.
- 'til Mizora pressed her lips to his ear. A whisper breathed, a bargain made.
You've judged my affections wrongly - I am much closer to Lae'zel!
I've been seeing the world - finally living my life on my terms.
Actually, what you were playing before was perfect.
And more to come. I will soon be assaulting a githyanki stronghold in the jungles of Chult.
The Blade has been busy - Avernus is my hunting ground now.
Report: Stone Lord Killed by Beloved Ranger
Is my pact amusing to you?
Gond's true name is Nebelun. Whatever he goes by, he's nothing more than a glorified cobbler.
Oh stop it, you. We'll be back before you know it. Tonight, let's just enjoy ourselves, and catch up with old friends.
We mean to slay every last sarth and kith'rak. Perhaps the Shar's most favoured daughter would care to join us.
The same might be said for all of us, I'd wager. But so long as our paths have thrown us together... I say we make the most of it.
I've devoted myself to rebuilding the city. A life of diplomacy and difficult bargains.
Prove it - say 'Ugh, the latrine's overflowing again - watch your step'.
And you must spend your nights waiting for one of your many enemies to cut your throat.
I'd be delighted. Though I'd need to appear psionically.
If you still want to journey away on the morrow, come and find me. Together, we will try hard not to have an adventure.
I feel... unburdened. I've redeemed myself at last.
*No mortal cell could hold you. The bars broke like bones.*
You found a job where you can talk as much as you like and people have to listen? Well done.
You? Hm. Always nice to me. Always give me pets. Would like that! Very much!
*What happens next will be by your design, and yours alone.*
I've fought stronger, faster, and more accomplished warriors than you. You cannot win.
*You are half an Illithid. Half a God. Below the gawking onlookers line up to die.*
Tara! How glad I am to see you!
At last I hear only silence. Blessed silence.
I've grown accustomed to my new form. It offers certain... possibilities, so long as I can master it.
But I'll leave such notions for the bards to pick over - not appropriate for someone of my standing to indulge in sentiment. Or at least, not often.
*He loves all living creatures. You wonder if he will forgive his own maggots.*
Oh no, people can be quite meek after seeing you murder their former master.
I'd quite like that. Thanks for the invitation.
Not like this. I want to feel you in the flesh.

I'll find my way back, as I always do. I admit defeat. Baldur's Gate is my home.
He's gone. We have to accept that.
I have been continuing to serve Lady Shar however I can.

To the Hero of the Realms,

We have followed your adventure closely, from the day you fell from that doomed nautiloid to the final blow you struck the Netherbrain as it loomed over the Sword Coast.

We are but a humble guild who pride ourselves in telling stories, not unlike the tales to be written of you for many years to come. How inspired we have been to witness your feats awesome and terrible; the lives you've saved and sundered; the friendships you've found.

Thus we thought to extend a greeting - to thank you for adventuring with such creative determination, such panache - enough to touch the hearts of each of our number.

With deepest gratitude,

The Guild of Great Genius
Not just a wizard - Professor Gale Dekarios of Blackstaff Academy, at your service.
The great vampire lord. Tell me - where is the best feeding ground in Baldur's Gate?
Mystra took possession of the Crown of Karsus, preventing any rivalry to her godly domain arising - for now.
I've been doing what I do best - keeping the Sword Coast safe.
But I am not unreasonable. I am willing to forgive this dalliance, on one condition.
Belligerent bard botherer - have ye no shame?
I don't know how to explain it. Maybe I don't need to.
Lae'zel is cunning. She wouldn't have let that happen.
Who knows? Maybe we'll have it again some day. Maybe even sooner than you think.
That joke was as funny as night orchids are poisonous.
Though she does insist on joining diplomatic missions in human guise.
You may not wish to enter the heavens, but you do a fine job conjuring them here.
And it looks like wedded bliss is suiting you...
Though she spends more time locking up comrades for pocketing aid funds. They might learn a thing or two, if they don't expel her. Again.
*It's no use - you feel control slipping away. The Grand Design shall not be denied.*
*You were dining with folk on some nameless frontier when the invitation came to you - an invitation to look back to where all of this began.*
So, if a certain warlock sought a more powerful patron - perhaps That Which Lurks itself, you might help with that?
Call on a red dragon and follow Orpheus. Vlaakith must be vanquished for good.
Alter the difficulty of your game, affecting your achievements.
I've missed travelling with you. You were a pleasure to be around.
Gale Dekarios trusted you. And do you know what became of him?
*Waterdeep is waiting for you - it's time to go home.*
I've just been trying to live my life, away from Shar's shadow. Isn't always easy, but I'm managing.
I'm sorry to hear things have been so difficult. You have my sympathy, but not my pity. If anyone can do what needs doing, it's you.
*Mystra has already spoken. There is nothing else for you here.*
Have you had any time to visit your father?
Smell what? The material plane can hardly compete with the aromas of Elysium.
I can't say I miss it. The blood, the gore, the ever-present threat of death...
You never were one to shy from battle - or to deny its thrills.
When enabled (default), the game will target 4K 60 FPS upscaled. Disable this feature for quality mode: the game will run on a native 4K at 30 FPS.
Your troubles have been many. But Boo believes choppy seas make a skilled sailor. It is why he requires Minsc to swim in the Sea of Swords each day at dawn!
I've missed you so much, Wyll. The Blade of Avernus.
Of course, after you've saved an entire city, saving one more person is probably below you.
Your sources are wrong. I'm free of Mizora - I'm a true hero now.
Or wasting any of the wine, for that matter. I plan on downing half a bottle myself. Oops - did I say half a bottle? I meant half a dozen.
Hardly - campaigning at Lae'zel's side against Vlaakith is no picnic. Makes me pine for the good old days.
We can do better than a nightcap, surely? A little hedonism, perhaps? Just a touch of debauchery?
Vlaakith's forces hound me. And every last sarth among them has fallen to my blade.
As my mother always says, 'if you can't find yourself in Waterdeep, you're not looking in the right mirror.'
Cazador really did teach you to ignore the stars in favour of your gutter.
*Should the githzerai join you, you could vanquish Vlaakith in a red dragon's blink.*
If that's what he told you, who am I to argue?
Mizora's gets involved every chance she gets, I imagine.
Pray to you, huh? I'll, uh... I'll consider that.
The 'beast's master' has already left the city - I found his resignation letter. Your waters are safe.
The last time I saw you, you were running from the sun. What happened?
It was far from a sure thing - I have very high standards, when it comes to festivities.
And you, Minthara? Can I be happy for you?
It seems your report was good, W'wargaz. Glad you could join us, Lae'zel.
Of course I am. Perhaps just... the long way around. It would be good to stretch my legs for a bit.
You could choose to lay down your blade, to lay down your life, to give up your soul. That you do not tells me which life matters most to you.
I fight for Tu'narath, but I do not know it as I know the Gate. Tu'narath is necessary, but the Gate I have felt for.
The likes of Gortash can bend people's minds with a few chosen words, no tadpole needed.
Unsheathe a set of hexed sickles and rip your warlock's enemy to shreds.
I've taken a breather in Limbo with Lae'zel, after myriad battles in the Astral Plane.
You've only to ask, my love. We can stop in on the way home.
It's harder work than I'd expected, actually. I'll never take vegetables for granted after all the effort it's taken to grow a few, but still... it's mine. Well, mine and the lodgers.
I wished to pay respects to the noble Lord of Song - it's an honour.
Does Jaheira know you're off the leash?
What business would that be? Troublemaking, no doubt.
Remember - thou canst only remove adventurers fully authored by mortal hands. Seekest thy fellow, and ask them to wait in thy camp.
Your works ripple all the way to Elysium. You're leaving quite a mark on the city.
This is a dangerous object. I'm not sure we should be playing with it.
You cannot evict squatters during a crisis. I'll ensure you don't.
I confess, when I left Waterdeep there was a part of me afraid that I might regret my decision. But I never have.
I wager you've cracked open more kith'raki heads than you could possibly count.
Not one juicy secret to be heard. Such a pity.
There is much merriment to be made before the night is done. Go, and greet the others - Minsc shall make himself presentable.
Likewise. And I'm glad at least one of us was confident in your return - it hasn't always been easy, wondering if something might've happened to you and Karlach in that place...
Ah, so it's the healthy glow you get from being a good person? That explains my pallor.
There was never any doubt, Hells or not. I've missed you.
So I have! Though it is a peace made more from blade and boot than it is any sense of brotherhood.
After everything we pulled off together, a little slice of normalcy sounds like just the thing.
True. But what better revenge could there be than enslaving the abomination that was the author of my torment.
I did. But meeting you, travelling that strangest of roads together, I learned to see myself differently. See the Weave differently.
I didn't expect you of all people to be judgemental.
Now, we have much to catch up on. Do not allow me to ramble on - I am eager to hear all you have been doing.
Please, let's put this behind us. I promise it'll never happen again.
Do I? I don't mean to. Being a Harper is like trying to roll a jotun up a sliding glacier.
I claimed the Crown of Karsus, became the god of ambition and established my new domain in Elysium.
I remain dedicated to the Coast. I will slay every last monster that threatens the people.
Tell me what you've been up to.
We found some blueprints and a map to Zariel's private forge, so if we can find a smith, and get the materials, and it's not a trap - there's a chance.
I see... well, perhaps not all friendships are destined to be balanced and reciprocal. But I remain eternally grateful for having met you, all the same. Rest well.
Concert Held In Memory of Volothamp Geddarm: Descends Into Disarray
Florrick, bless her soul, convinced him to withhold the lashings and scoldings, though I know he was tempted.
That wouldn't have been your style even when you were just a man, would it?
To burning bright, and never going out.
I didn't ask earlier - what were you doing in the Fugue Plane?
But! Such is the way of love, isn't it?
You've never been far from my mind. Even when lopping off a royal kith'rak's head.

I wish I could see more of my parents, but we manage to stay in touch. They're well, settled at a cottage I found for them. Perhaps one day Lae'zel will have her fill of battle, and we can go join them for good.
What, thought I'd be late, as I don't have a Butler to check the time?
Soon - once you've restored Karlach's heart, once the lich queen has crumbled to dust.
The tapestry of fate, however, will not forget. Nor will I.
I am sure you'll make the best of it. But you'll do it without me.
That sounds... foreboding. I'm not entirely sure I want to know more.
A many-sided artefact of blackened iron, engraved with pulsating runes. Something stirs within.
Your ambition is not cruel, but you fear that if you indulge it, you will lose yourself in the mysteries of the Weave and unravel the world.
The hellhunt is both duty and thrill. The demons I've disintegrated, the devilkin I've bled - the stories I could tell.

Ally mine,

It has been a full half-year since last we spoke. Your great victory against the wicked brain of brains still plays before my eyes by nights; ho, it was a sight I'll cherish for the remainder of my infinite days. I hope these last turns of my mother's face in the sky have brought you rest and peace.

But rest has not found Dame Aylin, no - I pursue the heels of a villain no less foul than the so-called 'Absolute'. An assailant who has targeted Selûnite enclaves across the coast. But fear not! Dame Aylin will find them. And you have seen yourself what she does to those deserving of her boot.

The road is long. It is lonely. And I have not forgotten all I've lost. But I cherish what I have found, too.

Yours eternally,

Dame Aylin Daughter of the Moonmaiden Selûne The Nightsong-no-more Anon and Everlasting
*Your life is your own now, and you are already becoming someone new.*
I used to climb it when father's eye was turned elsewhere - daydream of the legends it might tell, if I listened close enough.
I'm being strong. It's what she would have wanted.
I'd like you to change the song.
Good. Your mother and I are going mushroom foraging in the morning. I'd hate to be too tired to suss the best pickings.
You have not asked about my activities since your departure, but you should know I have been thriving.
An error occurred when trying to take the photo.
Go on, you've got mingling to do. I'll work on my punchlines some more.
The feeling is very mutual. Even if I was laughing behind your back.
One illithid for the whole of Faerûn seems like a fair trade to me.
...Be still, Boo. Think of our friends.
No. The Blackstaff would never allow it. Health and safety, you see - it's all the rage in wizardry these days.
I've missed travelling with you. You were a pleasure to be around.
I say we sneak in under cover of night. We slit every last throat and you feed until your belly's full.
I have negotiated the handover of hostages and smiled politely while sensing a dagger at my back.
You seem happy. Have you been drinking?
Are you and your illithid lover still together?
